daily.today_energy: Mars and Jupiter are both in Leo right now, amplifying your natural confidence and drive. The Sun squaring Mars adds some friction though—you've got tons of energy but it might feel scattered. Channel it into something concrete instead of spreading yourself thin.
daily.love: Venus in Libra is keeping things balanced and thoughtful in your romantic sphere. You're more interested in genuine connection than drama today. If you're single, your charm is naturally elevated. If coupled, a real conversation about what you both want could go really well.
daily.career: With Mars conjunct Jupiter in your sign, you're basically radiating ambition and capability. This is your moment to pitch ideas or take on bigger responsibilities. Just watch that overconfidence—Saturn retrograde is reminding you that solid prep beats raw talent alone.
daily.health: Your energy levels are genuinely high right now, which is great for movement and exercise. Just make sure you're actually resting too; this Mars-Jupiter combo can make you feel invincible but you're still human. Pace yourself.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is asking you to lean into your natural magnetism, Leo. There's a subtle shift happening—less about being seen, more about being felt. Trust the quiet magic you're carrying right now.
weekly.love: Someone's noticing the depth beneath your shine. Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower this week. Let people see the real you, not just the highlight reel version. Connection deepens when you do.
weekly.career: Your creative instincts are *chef's kiss* right now. If you've been sitting on an idea, this is the week to test it out. Don't wait for perfect conditions—your momentum matters more than your timing ever will.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. High-intensity energy is great, but rest hits different when you actually honor it. Notice what makes you feel grounded, not just what makes you feel productive.
